policy: Profiles are validation-only dependency-tree rescue hints. They must not change matcher scoring, SBOM component selection, vulnerability labels, reference DB contents, or source-validated metrics unless a runtime dependency tree and validate-source-deps output are produced.

modern-android-missing-compile-sdk.purpose: Repair modern Android Gradle projects that fail before runtime classpath resolution because root Android SDK settings or plugin setup do not reach the app module under the current Docker Gradle lane.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: inject or preserve compileSdk/minSdk/targetSdk values needed for project configuration
prefer root app module dependency tasks over broad module guessing
disable build-time analysis plugins when they do not affect runtime dependency declarations

legacy-gradle-jdk11.purpose: Retry older F-Droid source trees with a JDK 11 and Gradle 5/6 style lane before classifying them as source-linked blocked.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: correct sdk.dir to /opt/android-sdk
remove stale ndk.dir lines when native build is not needed for Maven runtime dependency resolution
replace obsolete jcenter() wiring only when required for dependency metadata resolution

cordova-gradle.purpose: Resolve Cordova-era Android projects whose Gradle scripts fail before runtime classpath generation.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: patch Cordova Gradle script compatibility enough to list runtime dependencies
align Cordova build-tools metadata with Docker-installed Android SDK tools when needed for configuration
avoid building Cordova assets or APK outputs
keep Cordova rescue rows outside metrics unless validate-source-deps completes

android-module-only-validation-copy.purpose: Handle multi-project source tarballs where non-Android frontend, web, or CLI modules block configuration before the Android runtime classpath is resolved.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: limit settings.gradle to the real Android app module and local runtime library modules
omit deployment or frontend-only task wiring that is unrelated to APK runtime dependencies
preserve Android implementation/api dependency declarations and local runtime project links
keep the row outside metrics unless validate-source-deps completes

legacy-agp8-runtime-validation-copy.purpose: Retry older Android Gradle plugin projects whose source AGP cannot run under the Docker Gradle lane before runtime dependency-tree capture.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: upgrade only the Android Gradle plugin used for dependency-tree capture
add AGP-required namespace or BuildConfig flags when existing source declarations require them
preserve declared Maven runtime dependencies
keep the row outside metrics unless validate-source-deps completes

react-native-node-prebuild.purpose: Classify React Native/native-heavy rows that need Node/npm/prebuild tooling before Gradle can expose Android runtime dependencies.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: document required Node/npm/native toolchain pieces
do not treat missing Java/Kotlin dependency proof as matcher failure
keep framework-boundary rows outside metrics unless runtime dependency proof completes

included-build-plugin-isolation.purpose: Handle projects whose included Gradle build logic blocks dependency-tree generation before app module configuration.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: prefer repository-order fixes and bounded retries
avoid broad source rewrites that could change declared runtime dependencies
record plugin-build blockers as build-system evidence when unresolved

k9-plugin-lite-runtime-graph-validation-.purpose: K-9/Thunderbird Android lane: isolate included build-plugin overhead in a validation-only source copy while preserving the app-k9mail foss release runtime dependency graph.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: disable build-time quality, test, dependency-check, coverage, badging, and full-flavor plugin wiring that is not needed for runtime dependency listing
preserve app-k9mail, its foss release runtime project graph, and runtime implementation/api/project dependencies
comment build-time-only plugin aliases and non-foss/test/debug dependency blocks only in the validation copy
keep the row partial unless validate-source-deps completes against the generated fossReleaseRuntimeClasspath tree

modern-gradle9-ksp-detekt-validation-cop.purpose: OpenCloud-specific lane: disable KSP/Detekt/Sonar build-time plugins in a validation copy so Gradle 9.5 can configure app modules and resolve runtime dependencies.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: disable KSP plugin application and ksp compiler dependencies
disable Kotlin/Parcelize build plugins and kotlinOptions blocks when Gradle API compatibility prevents project configuration
disable Detekt/Sonar plugin application and Detekt task configuration
preserve runtime implementation/api dependencies and project module links

owncloud-modern-runtime-validation-copy.purpose: Retry ownCloud where modern Kotlin/KSP/analysis plugin wiring fails before :owncloudApp runtime classpath resolution under the current Docker Gradle lane.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: disable KSP, Kotlin, Parcelize, Ktlint, Detekt, Sonar, and CycloneDX build-time wiring in a validation copy
preserve ownCloud app/library modules and runtime implementation/api dependencies
pin dependency-tree capture to :owncloudApp runtime classpath configurations
keep the row outside metrics unless validate-source-deps completes

simplelogin-detekt-validation-copy.purpose: Retry SimpleLogin where the old Detekt report configuration fails before app runtime classpath resolution under the current Gradle lane.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: disable Detekt plugin application and Detekt task/report configuration
preserve the app module, product flavors, and runtime implementation/api dependencies
keep the row outside metrics unless validate-source-deps completes

omni-notes-analysis-plugin-validation-co.purpose: Retry Omni Notes where SonarQube/test-logger/Jacoco build-time analysis wiring fails before app runtime classpath resolution under the current Gradle lane.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: disable SonarQube and test-logger buildscript/plugin wiring
disable Jacoco report/test task configuration that is not needed for runtime dependency listing
preserve the omniNotes app module, foss product flavor, and runtime implementation/api dependencies
keep the row outside metrics unless validate-source-deps completes

strict-module-runtime-config.purpose: Retry source trees where the generic APK proof runner found the correct Gradle root but probed the wrong app module names.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: prefer the actual Android app module declared in settings.gradle
limit retries to runtime dependency configurations that naturally exist for that module
do not patch source files until a strict module/config retry proves the blocker is not only wrong-module probing

todo-agenda-archive-name-validation-copy.purpose: Retry Todo Agenda where obsolete APK archive output naming fails before runtime classpath resolution under the current Docker Gradle/AGP lane.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: omit the defaultConfig archivesBaseName output naming line in a validation copy
preserve app/colorpicker modules and runtime implementation/api/project dependencies
keep the row outside metrics unless validate-source-deps completes

jcenter-to-maven-central-validation-copy.purpose: Retry source trees that fail during Gradle configuration only because modern Gradle removed the jcenter() repository method.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: replace jcenter() repository method calls with mavenCentral() in a validation copy
preserve declared runtime implementation/api dependencies
keep rows outside metrics unless runtime dependency proof and source validation complete

openkeychain-fdroid-submodule-validation.purpose: Retry OpenKeychain's F-Droid source tarball where the wrapper root lacks settings.gradle and some local source submodules referenced by the app are absent from the tarball.
allowed_validation_copy_edits: add a settings.gradle that includes the real OpenKeychain Android app module and present local Android library modules
replace removed jcenter() repository method calls with mavenCentral() in the validation copy
omit missing local project module wires when the referenced source directories are absent from the F-Droid source tarball
enable buildConfig generation when the Android Gradle plugin requires it for existing custom BuildConfig fields
set android.useAndroidX=true when AGP refuses to resolve an AndroidX runtime classpath without the project property
preserve declared Maven runtime implementation/api dependencies
